psi.book.category.psitweaks.desc: $(thing)PsiTweaks$(0) expands Psi with stronger spell bullets, CAD parts, machinery, Mekanism integration, and late-game psionic materials.
psi.book.category.psitweaks_machines.des: Machine blocks and infrastructure added by PsiTweaks.
psi.book.category.psitweaks_spell_pieces: Spell pieces added by PsiTweaks. Many are offensive, industrial, or utility-focused, and some require research depending on the config.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_cad_and_gear.0: Several PsiTweaks items make spellcasting easier to carry, automate, or specialize. Some are direct CAD tools, while others support bullet handling or improve a caster's combat role.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_cad_and_gear.2: PsiTweaks also adds powerful CAD assemblies made from expensive ingots. When ordinary Psi equipment no longer keeps up, use them together with high-tier spell bullets and similar upgrades.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_cad_and_gear.3: $(thing)PsiTweaks$(0) adds five CAD material lines: $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_psion)Psionic Alloy$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_chaotic_psimetal)Chaotic Psimetal$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_flashmetal)Flashmetal$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_heavy_psimetal)Heavy Psimetal$(/l), and $(l:components/psitweaks_psycheonic_metal_ingot)Psycheonic Metal$(/l).$(p)Psionic Alloy CADs have excellent Efficiency but very small Potency. The other CAD assemblies improve in Efficiency and Potency as their materials move into later progression.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_changes.0: Installing $(thing)Psi: Tweaks And Additions$(0) applies several adjustments to improve QOL.$(p)Psi is no longer reduced when you take damage, and the Psi regeneration cooldown after casting is removed.$(p)In the Spell Programmer screen, spell pieces can be searched in English regardless of the current language setting.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_changes.1: In the Spell Programmer screen, hold Shift and left-drag across the grid to select multiple spell pieces. Selected spell pieces are highlighted in blue, and the copied range is shown with a blue outline.$(p)Hold Ctrl and left-click a spell piece to add it to or remove it from the selection. While multiple pieces are selected, use Ctrl+C to copy, Ctrl+X to cut, and Ctrl+V to paste. Pasting uses the cell currently selected in Psi as the upper-left corner of the copied range.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_idea_storage.0: $(thing)Ideaspace Storage$(0) is a personal virtual storage for each player holding items, fluids, Mekanism chemicals, and FE, and is never lost on death.$(p)Access it via $(l:psitweaks_spell_pieces/trick_idea_storage_view)$(o)Trick: View Ideaspace Storage$(0)$(/l), automate it with transfer/selector pieces, or link pipes via $(l:psitweaks_spell_pieces/trick_ideaspace_connector)$(o)Trick: Ideaspace Connector$(0)$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_idea_storage.1: Right-clicking this $(item)Program: Ideaspace Storage$(0) unlocks all Ideaspace Storage spell pieces at once without consuming the program.$(p)See $(l:psitweaks/research)Research$(/l) for how to craft programs.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.auto_caster: Auto Casters are worn in Curios slots and cast spells automatically.$(p)Change their spell bullets with the Curios Controller.
The tick model fires every tick. The custom tick model lets you set an interval from 1 to 1200 ticks by using the item.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.blade_pouch: A pouch that holds up to 8 swords. Using it opens a GUI that only accepts items in $(thing)#minecraft:swords$(0).$(p)$(l:psitweaks_spell_pieces/trick_dancing_blades)$(o)Trick: Dancing Blades$(0)$(/l) deploys every sword in it. While the blades are out, swords cannot be put in or taken out.

Only one pouch is used at a time. As with the Filter Card, the Curios slots (it fits any slot) are searched first, then the main hand, the offhand, the hotbar and the inventory, and the first pouch found is used.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.blank_progr: Used as the base item for program research. Put it into the $(l:psitweaks_machines/program_researcher)$(o)$(item)Program Research Table$(0)$(/l) with the required materials to create a written program.$(p)It can also be crafted with an existing written program item to duplicate that program.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.curios_cont: Switches the selected bullet slot of Auto Casters and other socketable items in Magic Calculation Area slots, the same way the Exosuit Controller does.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.filter_card: A card that holds up to 9 sample items for spell filters. Using it opens a GUI; clicking a slot with an item registers a copy with a count of 1 without using up the item. Click with an empty hand or shift-click to clear a slot.$(p)Selector: Filter Card reads the item in the slot whose number (1 to 9) you give it.

Only one card is used at a time. The Curios slots (it fits any slot) are searched first, then the main hand, the offhand, the hotbar and the inventory, and the first card found is used.$(p)When you carry two or more cards, the unused ones look different.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.flash_charm: A Curios charm that continually removes Blindness and Darkness from the wearer.$(p)It also works while carried in inventory, making it useful in the Deep Dark and against vision-disrupting effects.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.gravstringe: The $(item)Gravstringer$(0) is an upgraded version of the Psimetal Bow. Arrow damage and draw speed are greatly improved, it has no durability, and it provides 11 spell bullet sockets.$(p)It can fire its dedicated $(item)Tunneler$(0) ammunition.

Sneak + left-click cycles the firing mode. Firing modes only apply when firing Tunnelers.$(li)Normal: fires 3 high-speed arrows that fly straight, unaffected by gravity for 5 seconds.$(li)Slow: fires 3 extremely slow arrows that are unaffected by gravity. They expire after 60 seconds.$(li)Hybrid: a volley with a Normal arrow in the center and Slow arrows on both sides.$(p)The cast spell bullet is applied only to the center arrow.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.inline_cast: Inline, Secondary, and Parallel Casters are handheld spellcasting tools with their own bullet sockets. They still require the caster to have a CAD, but the selected bullet is stored in the caster item itself.
The Inline Caster has one slot, the Secondary Caster has five, and the Parallel Caster has eleven.$(p)Use them when you want to carry many spell bullets without constantly changing the CAD.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.interferenc: Equips in the Magic Calculation Area slot and extends Psi spell and raycast range to 64 blocks.$(p)It is a lower-tier alternative to the Third-Eye Device; when both are equipped, the Third-Eye Device takes priority.
The $(item)M.O.V.A.L. Suit$(0) is a high-grade Psi armor set crafted with $(l:components/psitweaks_heavy_psimetal)$(o)$(item)Heavy Psimetal$(0)$(/l) and $(item)Ebony Psimetal$(0).

The helmet accepts exosuit sensors, the chestplate casts on damage, the leggings cast on tick, and the boots cast on jump.$(p)Each piece grants +10%% Phenomenon Interference, +5 Psi regeneration, and +500 maximum Psi.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.philosopher: A reusable catalyst that provides interconversion recipes for metals, diamonds, coal, ender pearls, and other resources.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.portable_ca: A handheld CAD Assembler. Use it to open an assembler interface without placing the block, making it easy to adjust CAD parts or loaded spell bullets while away from base.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.portable_sp: A handheld Spell Programmer. Right-click to open the same spell programming screen as the Spell Programmer.

Hold the Portable Spell Programmer in your main hand and a spell bullet or CAD in your offhand, then sneak-right-click to register the spell you are editing. For a CAD or another socketable device, this writes to its currently selected spell bullet.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.sorcery_boo: Equips in the Magic Calculation Area slot and increases Phenomenon Interference by 30%%.$(p)It is made from a $(item)Magician's Head$(0).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.spell_magaz: Stores up to twelve spell bullets and swaps them with the matching slots of your equipped CAD when used.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.third_eye_d: Equips in the Magic Calculation Area slot and removes Psi's normal spell radius check for the caster.$(p)This lets spells target positions far beyond ordinary CAD range limits, so use it carefully.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_item.tunneler.0: The $(item)Tunneler$(0) is the dedicated ammunition of the $(item)Gravstringer$(0). It pierces through blocks and nullifies armor and resistances. It never strikes its shooter.$(p)The arrow pierces through mobs instead of disappearing, striking the same target again after a 1-second cooldown.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_lists.0: A List groups multiple values of the same type.$(p)Psi mostly uses Entity List; PsiTweaks also supports String List, Number List, Vector List, Item List, and Block List.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_lists.2: PsiTweaks adds operators for working with Lists.$(p)They can retrieve elements or list size, add, remove, insert, slice, search, exclude, intersect, and concatenate values.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.autonomo: A machine that automatically casts Spell Bullets using its own internal Psi.$(li)Place Spell Bullets at top left (Loopcast unsupported)$(li)Feed $(item)Psionic Echo Gas$(0) to build internal Psi$(li)Apply a redstone signal

Use $(item)Config$(0) to choose the bullet, trigger, and look angles. Pulse casts once on signal, Level repeats at the interval, and $(item)Cast$(0) runs a single test cast.$(p)Casts from the front along the set direction, previewable via the left tab. The loop counter increments per cast and resets on bullet change, the $(item)0$(0) button, or $(item)Trick: Break Loop$(0).

Base internal CAD stats: Efficiency 175, Potency 1500, Complexity 46, Projection 10, Bandwidth 9, Memory 21. Install up to 3 upgrades in the right $(item)Upgrades$(0) tab, and place a Colorizer below the gauges.$(p)The 36 lower slots act as the caster's inventory, with the bottom row as the hotbar. The slot chosen in $(item)Config$(0) counts as right of the CAD, and overflow drops in front.

By default, converts 10 mB of $(item)Psionic Echo Gas$(0) per Psi (up to 25 Psi/t, max 10,000 Psi). Feed gas from any side or the upper gauge slot, supply bullets via an input side, and read internal Psi with a Comparator.$(p)Debug output and errors go to the $(item)Activity Log$(0). Breaking the machine keeps everything except the log and loop counter.

Ideaspace Storage spells access the owner's storage. $(item)Trick: Spin Chamber$(0) and $(item)Trick: Russian Roulette$(0) switch the selected bullet without resetting the loop counter.$(p)$(item)Trick: Psi Bullet$(0) and $(item)Trick: Gram Demolition$(0) spare SpellGram objects belonging to the machine and its owner. Spells that open GUIs or use the Eidos Changelog have no effect.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.cad_disa: A workbench for disassembling CADs and recovering their parts. Sneak-right-click it with a CAD to break the CAD into its installed components and loaded spell bullets.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.material: A Mekanism injecting-style machine that performs material mutation with $(item)Psionic Echo Gas$(0) and energy.$(p)It automates mutations that can also be produced by $(l:psitweaks_spell_pieces/trick_material_mutation)$(o)Trick: Material Mutation$(0)$(/l), such as $(l:components/psitweaks_jade)Jade$(/l) and $(l:components/psitweaks_hypostasis_gem)Hypostasis Gems$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.program_: A powered research table for producing PsiTweaks program items. Put the required ingredients in the input slots and supply FE; completed research outputs the program item.$(p)JEI shows each research recipe's energy usage per tick and time.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.psionic_: A generator that links to its Mekanism owner and converts that player's Psi into energy while the owner is online.$(p)Use the GUI to enable the link and set the Psi consumed per tick. Higher consumption gives higher output and drains the owner faster.$(p)By default, generated energy auto-outputs from the back, up to 25600 FE/tick.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.sculk_er: A machine that corrodes stone, dirt, sand, and related block items into Sculk outputs.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.spellmac: A casing block used to execute advanced magic through machinery.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.transcen: An upgraded version of Mekanism's Energy Cube. It has 128 times the capacity and output of the Ultimate Energy Cube, making it suitable for buffering fission reactor-class power.
An upgraded version of Mekanism's Universal Cable. It has 128 times the performance of the Ultimate Cable, making it suitable for fusion reactor-class power output.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_machine.zone_fee: Feeds FE into Charged Zones. Accepts and outputs FE from any side and retains stored FE when broken.

When the owner's $(l:psitweaks_spell_pieces/trick_charged_zone)Charged Zone$(/l) covers this block, it supplies extra FE whenever the zone's own capacity runs short. Glows while feeding; right-click with an empty hand to check stored FE.$(p)Connect cables from outside the zone, as cables inside also receive the zone's FE.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_magician.1: $(thing)Magicians$(0) are a villager profession added by PsiTweaks. An unemployed villager becomes one by claiming a $(l:basics/cad_assembler)$(o)$(item)CAD Assembler$(0)$(/l) as its job site; place it where a villager can reach it.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.alloy_h: Made by infusing $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_psionic_echo)$(o)$(item)Echo Alloy$(0)$(/l) with Hypostasis.$(p)Used for $(l:components/psitweaks_hypostasis_control_circuit)$(o)$(item)Hypostasis Control Circuits$(0)$(/l) and high-tier psionic machinery.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.alloy_p: Made by infusing Mekanism's Reinforced Alloy with Psigem.$(p)Used for $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_control_circuit)$(o)$(item)Psionic Control Circuits$(0)$(/l), Psionic Alloy CAD assemblies, and the next alloy tier.

Made by infusing $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_psion)$(o)$(item)Psionic Alloy$(0)$(/l) with $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_echo)Psionic Echo$(/l).$(p)Used for $(l:components/psitweaks_echo_control_circuit)$(o)$(item)Echo Control Circuits$(0)$(/l) and as the base for $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_hypostasis)Hypostasis Alloy$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.antinit: Smelted from Antinite ore or recovered from Antinite blocks. The dust, shard, clump, crystal, and dirty dust forms are intermediate products in Mekanism-style ore processing.$(p)Used as a material for $(l:components/psitweaks_hypostasis_gem)Hypostasis Gems$(/l) and the $(l:items/psitweaks_philosophers_stone)$(o)$(item)Philosopher's Stone$(0)$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.chaotic: $(item)Chaotic Factor$(0) starts with infusing an $(item)Ender Pearl$(0) with Psigem to make $(item)Psionic Factor$(0). Infuse that with Ivory or Ebony to make the aligned factor variants, then cross the opposite alignment to create $(item)Chaotic Factor$(0).$(p)Used as the infusion source for $(l:components/psitweaks_chaotic_psimetal)$(o)$(item)Chaotic Psimetal$(0)$(/l), the first major PsiTweaks metal above ordinary Psimetal.

Made by infusing ordinary $(item)Psimetal$(0) with $(l:components/psitweaks_chaotic_factor)Chaotic Factor$(/l).$(p)Used in recipes for Chaotic Psimetal CAD assemblies and $(l:components/psitweaks_unrefined_flashmetal)$(o)$(item)Unrefined Flashmetal$(0)$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.dimensi: Occasionally, casting a spell yields a $(item)Dimensional Crystal$(0). The chance increases in proportion to the amount of Psi the cast consumes.$(p)It cannot be crafted. If you want to gather them steadily, you need to make spellcasting part of your daily life.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.echo_co: Crafted from $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_control_circuit)$(o)$(item)Psionic Control Circuit$(0)$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_psionic_echo)$(o)$(item)Echo Alloy$(0)$(/l), and $(l:components/psitweaks_echo_sheet)HDΨE Sheets$(/l).$(p)Used in recipes for advanced spell bullets and machinery.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.echo_pe: A compact HDΨE material made from $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_echo)Psionic Echo$(/l) processing.$(p)Used where recipes need condensed echo material rather than raw $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_echo)Psionic Echo$(/l). The ΨE-O Fuel produced as a byproduct can be used as fuel for the Gas Generator.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.echo_sh: Made by enriching HDΨE material into a sheet form.$(p)Used heavily in Echo and Hypostasis Control Circuit recipes.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.flashme: Made by enriching $(l:components/psitweaks_unrefined_flashmetal)$(o)$(item)Unrefined Flashmetal$(0)$(/l).$(p)Used for Flashmetal blocks, Flashmetal CAD assemblies, $(l:components/psitweaks_heavy_psimetal)Heavy Psimetal$(/l), and sublimated-tier spell bullets.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.gravito: $(item)Graviton Factor$(0) cannot be made by crafting or infusing. Drop a $(item)Quantum Factor$(0) as an item and let it fall 380 blocks; the strain of the fall rewrites it into a $(item)Graviton Factor$(0) in mid-air. The stack count is carried over as-is.$(p)Use Add Motion, a Gravity Zone or another mod's jetpack, or prepare a drop shaft from near the build limit, and collect it at the bottom.
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.heavy_p: Crafted from $(l:components/psitweaks_heavy_psimetal_scrap)$(o)$(item)Heavy Psimetal Scrap$(0)$(/l) and $(l:components/psitweaks_flashmetal)$(o)$(item)Flashmetal$(0)$(/l).$(p)Used for stronger CAD assemblies, gear, and the $(l:components/psitweaks_psycheonic_metal_ingot)Psycheonic Metal chain$(/l).

Made by infusing Netherite Scrap with $(l:components/psitweaks_psionic_echo)Psionic Echo$(/l).$(p)Used with $(l:components/psitweaks_flashmetal)$(o)$(item)Flashmetal$(0)$(/l) to craft $(l:components/psitweaks_heavy_psimetal)$(o)$(item)Heavy Psimetal$(0)$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.hyposta: Crafted from $(l:components/psitweaks_echo_control_circuit)$(o)$(item)Echo Control Circuit$(0)$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_hypostasis)$(o)$(item)Hypostasis Alloy$(0)$(/l), and $(l:components/psitweaks_echo_sheet)HDΨE Sheets$(/l).$(p)Used for the highest machinery.

Made by applying material mutation to an $(item)Antinite Block$(0), either with the spell trick or the $(l:psitweaks_machines/material_mutator)Material Mutator$(/l).$(p)It can be enriched and converted into Hypostasis infusion, and is also used for $(l:components/psitweaks_magatama)$(o)$(item)Magatama$(0)$(/l), $(l:components/psitweaks_alloy_hypostasis)Hypostasis Alloy$(/l), and the $(l:components/psitweaks_psycheonic_metal_ingot)Psycheonic Metal chain$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.jade: Made by applying material mutation to an $(item)Emerald Block$(0), either with the spell trick or the $(l:psitweaks_machines/material_mutator)Material Mutator$(/l).$(p)Used as the main material for crafting $(l:components/psitweaks_magatama)$(o)$(item)Magatama$(0)$(/l).
psi.book.page.psitweaks_material.magatam: Crafted from $(l:components/psitweaks_jade)$(o)$(item)Jade$(0)$(/l) surrounding a $(l:components/psitweaks_hypostasis_gem)$(o)$(item)Hypostasis Gem$(0)$(/l).$(p)Used in $(l:psitweaks_machines/spellmachinery_casing)Spellmachinery Casings$(/l), making it a bridge between material mutation and advanced psionic machinery.
