psitweaks.spellpiece.jump_anchor.desc: A no-op marker used as the destination for Trick: Jump and Trick: Switch. It can take an optional constant label.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_caster_axial_: Offsets a position by Left/Right, Forward/Backward, and Up/Down relative to the caster's horizontal facing. Positive values move right, forward, and up. Pitch is ignored.
Like Macro: Caster Axial Offset, but the facing also follows the pitch. When looking straight up or down, forward points vertically and the offset plane becomes horizontal.
Rotates a direction vector from the caster's view frame (X = right, Y = up, Z = forward) into world space. Facing is rounded to the nearest horizontal cardinal direction. Pitch is ignored.
Like Macro: Caster Axial Rotation, but the facing also follows the pitch (X = right, Y = view-up, Z = forward), including when looking straight up or down.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_caster_raycas: Raycasts from the caster's position in the look direction and returns the coordinates of the hit block.
Raycasts from the caster's position in the look direction and returns the normal direction of the hit face.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_caster_strong: Like Macro: Caster Raycast, but blocks without a collision shape are ignored.
Like Macro: Axis Caster Raycast, but blocks without a collision shape and fluids are ignored.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_caster_weak_r: Like Macro: Caster Raycast, but it also hits fluids such as water and lava.
Like Macro: Axis Caster Raycast, but it also hits fluids such as water and lava.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_face_axial_of: Offsets a position along axes aligned to the block face under the caster's crosshair. If Position is omitted, the hit block is used. Positive values move screen-right, into the block, and screen-up.
psitweaks.spellpiece.macro_face_axial_ro: Rotates a direction vector using the orientation of the block face hit by the caster's raycast as its reference.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_alive.desc: Keeps only LivingEntity instances that are currently alive in the input Entity List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_block_free: Outputs how much more of one item, fluid or chemical ID, or FE, a block can accept now.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_block_item: Gets the item that Pick Block gives for the block, as an Item.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_block_posi: Outputs the saved position of a Block value as a plain Vector.
Gets the positions of the blocks in a Block List as a Vector List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_block_reso: Outputs the items, fluids, chemicals or FE stored in a block, chosen by the mode. String narrows it down by ID, or by tag when it starts with #.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_block_stat: Outputs the saved block state of a Block value as a String. Example: minecraft:oak_stairs[facing=north]
Outputs the saved block state properties of a Block value as a String List.
Outputs one saved block state property value from a Block value.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_connected_: Lists the positions of the blocks of the same kind connected to the block at the position.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_dropped_it: Turns the dropped items in an Entity List into an Item List. Other entities are skipped.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_equal.desc: Outputs 1 if Value 1 equals Value 2, otherwise 0.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_format_str: Returns the entered text with Values 1 to 3 filled into {1}, {2}, and {3}.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_from_strin: Returns the input String as-is, or converts it into a Number or Vector for the selected mode.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_get_id.des: Outputs the registry ID of a Contextual Value.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_get_id_lis: Outputs registry IDs from a Contextual Value List as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_greater_th: Outputs 1 if Value 1 is greater than Value 2, otherwise 0.
Outputs 1 if Value 1 is greater than or equal to Value 2, otherwise 0.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_inside_reg: Keeps only the elements of an Entity, Vector or Block List that are inside the matrix region. Choose the list type in the mode menu.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_item_count: Outputs the stack count of an Item value.
Outputs the internal inventory slot number saved on an Item value. Outputs -1 if no slot number is available.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_item_total: Outputs the total count of matching items in an Item List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_add.d: Adds up to three elements to the input List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_dista: Outputs the element at the index when the List is sorted closest first. 0 is the closest; negative numbers count from the farthest.
Keeps as many elements as the Number, closest to the position first. A negative Number keeps the farthest ones.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_exclu: Removes the elements in List 2 from the input List 1.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_from_: Returns the input String List as-is, or converts it into a Number List or Vector List for the selected mode.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_inser: Inserts the input element at the specified index in the input List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_inter: Outputs the elements shared by the two input Lists.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_name_: Keeps only the List elements whose display name matches the pattern. The whole name must match; * ? [abc] work.
Removes the List elements whose display name matches the pattern. The whole name must match; * ? [abc] work.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_nbt_r: Operator: List Keep NBT In Range
Keeps the List elements whose number at the NBT Path is between Min and Max. An unconnected bound is open.
Operator: List Keep NBT Out Of Range
Keeps the List elements whose number at the NBT Path is below Min or above Max.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_nbt_s: Keeps the List elements whose NBT value at the NBT Path matches the pattern. The whole value must match; * ? [abc] work.
Removes the List elements whose NBT value at the NBT Path matches the pattern. The whole value must match; * ? [abc] work.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_remov: Removes up to two elements from the input List.
Removes the elements at Number A and Number B from the input List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_searc: Keeps only the List elements whose ID or string form matches the pattern. The whole string must match; * ? [abc] work. Start with # to compare tags.
Removes the List elements whose ID or string form matches the pattern. The whole string must match; * ? [abc] work. Start with # to compare tags.
Outputs the number of elements in the input List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_slice: Returns the part of the List from Number A to Number B.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_to_st: Converts an Any input into a debug-display String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_list_value: Outputs the element at the index when the List is sorted by value, smallest first. 0 is the smallest; negative numbers count from the largest.
Keeps the Number elements with the smallest values. A negative Number keeps the largest ones.
Operator: List Keep In Value Range
Keeps the List elements whose value in Values is between Min and Max. An unconnected bound is open.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_add: Adds two or three matrices of the same size.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_cas: Builds a 4x4 matrix from the caster's axis-rounded facing (columns: right, up, forward, origin), so regions can follow the caster.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_col: Converts a Number List or Vector into a column matrix.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_cub: Builds a 4x4 matrix for the axis-aligned cuboid with two positions as opposite corners. Block mode includes both corner blocks.
Builds a 4x4 matrix for an axis-aligned cuboid from a center position and size. Whole-number sizes act as block counts on each axis. Number mode makes a cube from one size.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_del: Deletes the specified column from the matrix and shifts the remaining columns left.
Deletes the specified row from the matrix and shifts the remaining rows up.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_det: Computes the determinant of a square matrix.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_dia: Creates a diagonal matrix from a Number List or Vector.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_ext: Returns the specified column as a Number List.
Returns the specified row as a Number List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_fla: Flattens a matrix into a Number List in row-major order.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_ide: Creates an identity matrix of the given size.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_inv: Computes the inverse of a square matrix.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_mul: Multiplies a matrix by a column vector or Number List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_rep: Replaces a column, expanding the matrix with zeros as needed.
Replaces the element at the zero-based [row, column] indices with the input number.
Replaces a row, expanding the matrix with zeros as needed.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_rot: Builds a 4x4 matrix that rotates around Axis by Angle in radians, like Operator: Rotate Vector.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_sca: Multiplies a matrix by a number.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_set: Turns a region matrix around its center so that its Y axis points along Direction.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_sub: Subtracts two or three matrices of the same size.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_tra: Transforms a vector, or every vector of a Vector List, with a 3x3 or 4x4 matrix.
Builds a 4x4 matrix that moves points by Offset.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_matrix_zer: Creates a zero matrix with the given dimensions.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_number_lis: Converts a Number List with exactly three elements into a Vector.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_outside_re: Keeps only the elements of an Entity, Vector or Block List that are outside the matrix region. Choose the list type in the mode menu.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_player_nam: Outputs the player name if the Entity is a player, otherwise outputs an empty string.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_random_ele: Outputs one random element from the input List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_region_vec: Returns block position vectors inside a matrix-defined region.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_strict_ite: Turns an Item or Item List into a filter that also compares data components.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_end: Outputs 1 if String 1 ends with String 2, otherwise outputs 0.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_len: Returns the number of characters in the input String as a Number.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_lis: Joins the input String List with String 2 and outputs a String.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_par: Outputs 1 if part of String 1 matches the pattern in String 2, otherwise 0. * matches any text, ? one character, and [abc] one of a, b, or c.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_rep: Replaces parts of String 1 matching String 2 with String 3.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_sli: Returns the part of the String from Number A to Number B.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_spl: Splits String 1 with String 2 as a literal delimiter and outputs a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_sta: Outputs 1 if String 1 starts with String 2, otherwise outputs 0.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_string_tri: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from the input String.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_strong_ray: Raycasts from Position in the Ray direction, ignores blocks without a collision shape, and returns the coordinates of the hit block.
Raycasts from Position in the Ray direction, ignores blocks without a collision shape, and returns the normal direction of the face of the hit block.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_tag_list.d: Outputs the registry tags of the target Contextual Value (Entity, Item, Block, etc.) as a String List.
Converts an Any input into a debug-display String.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_vector_to_: Converts a Vector into a three-element Number List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.operator_weak_rayca: Raycasts from Position in the Ray direction and returns the coordinates of the hit block or fluid.
Raycasts from Position in the Ray direction and returns the normal direction of the face of the first block or fluid hit.
psitweaks.spellpiece.safety.desc: If the caster's Psi plus the CAD's stored Psi can't cover the cost, the spell fails without using any Psi.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_autonomous: Gets the center of the Autonomous Caster casting the spell
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_barrier_am: Gets the shield the target's Barrier has left. 0 when it has none.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_block.desc: Returns the block at the given position as a Block value.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_block_list: Gets the blocks at the positions in a Vector List as a Block List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_display_na: Outputs the localized display name of a Contextual Value.
Outputs localized display names from a Contextual Value List as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_effect_lis: Outputs the target Entity's active Mob Effect registry IDs as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_entity_slo: Gets the item in the target entity's zero-based internal inventory slot. Outputs an empty Item if the slot cannot be read.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_filter_car: Gets the item registered in the given slot (1-9) of the Filter Card in use
Gets the target entity's main-hand item. For a dropped item, gets its stack.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_held_items: Outputs the target entity's carried items as an Item List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_idea_stora: Returns the stored amount of the resource chosen by the mode: items, fluids, chemicals or FE.
Returns how much more of the resource chosen by the mode can be stored right now.
Selector: Ideaspace Storage - Last Transfer Amount
Returns the amount actually moved by the most recent Ideaspace transfer trick earlier in this cast.
Returns the number of stored types of the resource chosen by the mode.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_indexed_el: Outputs the element at a zero-based index from the selected List mode. Negative indexes count back from the end.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_internal_i: Outputs the target block's internal inventory as an Item List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_internal_s: Gets the item in a block's zero-based internal inventory slot. Outputs an empty Item if the slot cannot be read.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_nbt.desc: Outputs the entries of the compound or list at the NBT Path (the whole NBT when unconnected) as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_nbt_exists: Outputs 1 if the NBT Path reaches anything in the target's NBT, otherwise 0.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_nbt_keys.d: Outputs the keys of the compound at the NBT Path, or the indexes of a list, as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_nbt_number: Outputs one number per List element: the number at the NBT Path, or the Fallback (0 when unconnected).
Outputs the value at the NBT Path as a String or a Number, chosen by the mode. Outputs the Fallback when nothing is found.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_nearby_spe: Retrieve SpellGram objects around the specified position
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_online_pla: Outputs the names of online players in the world as a String List.
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_own_spellg: Lists your own Resident SpellGrams (circles and zones) in this dimension, in the order you placed them
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_selected_s: Gets the item currently selected by this spell.

Returns the current integrity of each SpellGram object in the List, as a Number List in the same order
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_stored_ent: Retrieve entities from the UUID stored in the CAD memory
psitweaks.spellpiece.selector_stored_val: Retrieve a Plain Value from CAD memory
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_acceleration_: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that speeds up the random ticks of growing things inside it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_active_air_mi: Deals magic damage to entities inside a spherical area around the target position
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_air_bullet.de: Fires a bullet of compressed air that strikes the first creature it hits
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_aqua_cutter.d: Launches a water blade projectile that damages on hit
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_barrier.desc: Raises a shield that takes damage in the target's place for one minute
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_blaze_ball.de: Launches a fireball forward that deals fire damage on hit
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_break_fortune: Break a block with Fortune applied
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_break_silk.de: Break a block with Silk Touch applied
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_breed.desc: Feeds the target animals from the caster's inventory so that they fall in love.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_burst.desc: Vaporizes the liquid inside the target so it bursts from within
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_chain_lightni: Discharges lightning from the focal point in the direction; it strikes the nearest hostile creature and branches to nearby ones
Places a Resident SpellGram zone that sends FE to the blocks, items and carried things inside it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_circle_follow: Makes your own circles follow you or an entity that is not a living being; without a Follow Target, lets them go
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_cocytus.desc: Blows a blizzard forward that freezes the minds of the mobs it catches forever
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_contamination: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that exposes the living beings inside it to radiation, up to a limit (needs Mekanism)
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_cure_radiatio: Removes radiation exposure from the target
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_dancing_blade: Deploys the swords in your Blade Pouch as blades that strike nearby hostile creatures
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_deceleration_: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that slows the living beings and projectiles inside it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_decontaminati: Places a Resident SpellGram core that clears the radiation sources within 32 blocks of it (needs Mekanism)
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_die_flex.desc: Stops the spell when given a number whose absolute value is below 1, and refunds the Psi of the pieces not yet run. In spells cast every tick, the Psi display may briefly desync.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_dispel_benefi: Remove beneficial effects from target entity
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_dispel_non_be: Remove non beneficial effects from target entity
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_dry_meteor.de: Launches dry ice forward and deals freezing damage on hit
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_explode_no_de: Cause an explosion that does not destroy blocks
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_extend_spellg: Restores the integrity of your own Resident SpellGram, so it lasts longer
Places a fire Resident SpellGram circle that repeatedly deals fire damage around it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_flight.desc: Applies the Flight effect to the target. Creative flight is enabled by continuously consuming Psi.
Freeze the block at the target position into its next colder form
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_freeze_zone.d: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that freezes living beings inside it and turns open water into ice
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_gram_demoliti: Blasts the SpellGram objects in front of you with psions, wearing their integrity away all at once
Places a Resident SpellGram zone that keeps pushing entities inside it in the given direction
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_guillotine.de: Deals a heavy slash to the target and drops a head on kill
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_hardening.des: When taking heavy damage, reduce it to a certain value
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_harvest.desc: Harvests the ripe crop at the position and replants it. The harvest goes into the caster's inventory.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_harvest_seque: Harvests and replants the ripe crops in a line from the position in the direction of the target.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_heat_zone.des: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that sets living beings inside it on fire and melts ice
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_ice_circle.de: Places an ice Resident SpellGram circle that repeatedly deals freeze damage around it and freezes the water in it

psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_interact_bloc: Right-click with the off-hand item on the target block
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_interference_: Places a Resident SpellGram zone that keeps weaker casters' Psi spells out of it and stops others' ender teleports
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_jump.desc: If the target number is unset or its absolute value is less than 1, jumps forward to the next Jump Anchor with the same constant label.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_jump_flex.des: Behaves like Trick: Jump and refunds the Psi of the pieces it skips.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_mass_block_br: Breaks blocks at the coordinates in a Vector List (a Block List also works). Drops go into the caster's inventory; only overflow is dropped.
Harvests and replants the ripe crops at the coordinates in a Vector List (a Block List also works). The harvest goes into the caster's inventory.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_material_muta: Acts on a specific block, alters its material structure, and transmutes it into a different substance.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_melt_block.de: Melt the block at the target position into its hotter form
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_meteor_line.d: Covers the position in a night and rains streaks of light from its stars on the creatures inside
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_micro_black_h: Creates a tiny black hole that pulls creatures in and swings them around, then collapses
Shakes the ground so a shockwave spreads out and throws up whatever stands on it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_molecular_div: divide the living creatures within the area
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_parade.desc: Conjures a lookalike of the caster that draws enemies' attacks and spells
Vibrates ultrasonic waves to emit heat rays
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_physical_prop: Raycasts from the specified position in the Ray direction; if it hits a Simulated Contraption, applies propulsion to it.
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_pseudo_meteor: Calls pseudo meteors down on the position and the hostile creatures around it
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_psi_bullet.de: Fires a bullet of psions that strikes the first creature or SpellGram object it hits
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_pull_item.des: Moves items from the specified face of the block at Position into the caster's inventory, up to one stack or the count given by Max.

Conjures a redstone emitting light in the given position

psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_radiation_fil: Applies a radiation filter effect to the target
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_recall_spellg: Takes back your own Resident SpellGrams

psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_shear.desc: Shears the target as shears would. What comes off goes into the caster's inventory.

Places a Resident SpellGram zone where no sound is heard and no vibration gets through

Store the entity's UUID string in the CAD memory

psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_supreme_infus: Infuse Echo Shards into Psionic Echoes

psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_time_accelera: Accelerates the time of the target block
psitweaks.spellpiece.trick_turbulence_zo: Places a Resident SpellGram zone where a gale turns projectiles aside and strengthens your other zones
